segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I pulled up the order form we discussed: 42 seats on the business plan, annual term starting August 15, and the services package for the workflow setup.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That sounds right. I just want to confirm the seat count. We have 38 confirmed users today, but finance asked us to include 4 extra for the operations team starting in September.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that’s exactly how I have it. The pricing sheet has those at $72 per seat per month, billed annually, so the software portion comes to $36,288 for the year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the implementation fee was separate, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. One-time implementation is $4,800. That includes two admin trainings, the data import, and the approval workflow configuration. Total first-year invoice would be $41,088 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. On timing, we need the first admin training the week of August 19. Is that still workable if we sign by Friday?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If we have signature by August 2, our onboarding team can hold Tuesday, August 20 at 11 a.m. Eastern or Thursday, August 22 at 2 p.m. Eastern.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Tuesday is better. Also, our legal team asked about the auto-renewal language. It says 30 days’ notice before the renewal date. Can that be 60?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, 60 days is fine. I’ll route that through deal desk today and update the order form. No change to pricing or start date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the revised version to me and copy Marcus in procurement. If it matches what we discussed, we should be able to get it signed this week.
